stem: [反洗钱和反恐怖融资合规标准]在没有制裁监管制度的国家,如何提高相关意识？(选择两项.)

options.A: 限制那些拥有健全的反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义和制裁监管制度的国家与那些没有此类制度的国家之间的贸易往来.
options.B: 在这些国家举办反金融犯罪(AFC)和制裁相关的研讨会、网络研讨会及培训.
options.C: 对这些国家实施强制措施和处以罚款.
options.D: 政府间的双边对话与合作.

stem_en: How can awareness be raised within countries that do not have sanctions regulatory regimes? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Restrict trade between countries that have robust AML/CFT and sanctions regulatory regimes and those that do not.
options_en.B: Conduct AFC (Anti-Financial Crime) and sanctions-related seminars, webinars, and training within these countries.
options_en.C: Enforcement and pecuniary fines against these countries.
options_en.D: Bilateral conversations and cooperation between governments.
